axisConvention: Unity world: panel is XY plane, +Z points toward viewer; Up=top hinge negative local X; Down=bottom hinge positive X; Left=left hinge negative local Y; Right=right hinge positive Y.
designIntent: One unique procedural cover Mesh and one stable shared Material per control; open and closed are rotations of the same Transform about a constant pivot; materials, meshes, UVs, thickness, and scale are never state-swapped.
visibleStatePolicy: Lighting and cast shadows may change as object rotates. Texture/color identity never changes.
dimensionProvenance: Only approximate owner-marked OH11 apertures and existing recorder sourceRect; other sizes are authoring preview proportions. No measured real-world sizes or approved pixel footprints.
oldLockedAssetsPolicy: DO_NOT_EDIT_OR_DELETE; never load locked open/closed guard sprites in new build
factoryGates: All 17 hinge values exactly match owner answers
Each control unique ID/material identity and new mesh
Each cover uses identical sharedMesh/sharedMaterial/localScale when opened/closed
All physical widths UNVERIFIED until source photos and socket survey
